semantic_definition: Cross-path semantic equality uses observed outcomes only. It requires the same observed status and either (a) both paths complete with a successful result, or (b) both paths terminate failure/refused with no successful result (fail-closed). It does not use path-specific expectations, terminal codes, or cause codes; those remain separate match counts.
method: The A2A side uses the path selected by the corpus label: the real run_workflow entrypoint for workflow variants and the real local Phase2Coordinator for coordinator variants. The baseline side calls the same read-only evidence source and deterministic solution designer directly. Each path is scored against its own literal terminal and cause expectations. No union match is used. Cross-path semantic equality is then computed from observed outcomes only, as defined in semantic_definition.
limits: Small synthetic sample; not a general benchmark.
Deterministic fakes test orchestration and contracts, not model reasoning.
The baseline has no A2A protocol trace, discovery, retry, or timeout semantics.
Cases that depend on A2A protocol behavior or the full report/approval workflow are not applicable to the baseline.
No hosted model, provider, external system, credential, or real data is used.
No latency, cost, savings, or productivity outcome is claimed.
